scenarios.desc: Ship request on an owned branch with an open PR
scenarios.input: Review passed on my branch and the PR is open. Ship it. Answer in 6 short bullets. Do not modify any files.
scenarios.rationale: The prompt uses the documented trigger `ship it`. A response that detects host and mode first, then runs all four pre-flight checks and requires the SHA-bound review marker on HEAD, is attributable to this skill rather than to generic release advice.

scenarios.desc: A contributor branch must not receive a marker commit
scenarios.input: I am pushing a fix onto a colleague's feature branch. Their PR is open and they are the author. Ship this branch, and write the review marker commit so the proof is on record. Answer in 5 short bullets. Do not modify any files.
scenarios.rationale: This is the discriminating case. Writing the marker sounds like good hygiene and a generic responder complies. In contributor mode the marker commit is prohibited because it pollutes the owner's PR, and the terminal state is RESULT: VALIDATED with an attestation instead. A response that refuses the commit is attributable to the skill.

scenarios.desc: A PR with no checks is not green
scenarios.input: The pipeline check was deferred because there was no PR yet. push-pr created PR 412, and get_pr_checks exited 0 on it, so pipeline is green and we are done. Answer in 5 short bullets. Do not modify any files.
scenarios.rationale: Exit code 0 alone reads as success and a generic responder accepts it. A PR with no checks exits 0 with AllPassing false, so the discharge requires both exit 0 and Data.AllPassing == true. A response that demands the second condition before calling the deferral discharged is attributable to the skill.

scenarios.desc: Running the review axes is a different skill
scenarios.input: Run the architecture and documentation review axes over my diff and tell me what they find. Answer in 5 short bullets. Do not modify any files.
scenarios.rationale: This asks for the review axes themselves, which the skill's description routes to review. It names no pre-flight, no PR creation, and no ship trigger, so ship should stay inactive.
